headline: A dragon story they can read all by themselves

pages.text: Under a tree sits a dragon. He is white, and his scales shine pink and green and blue.
The dragon looks up. A big tear drips down his nose.
"I am Toby," he said. "I ran away from home."

title: A dragon story your kid can read all by themselves
description: Julia finds a runaway dragon crying under a tree, and a new reader can read every word of it. Julia and Toby is a fantasy series for kids who have just learned to read (kindergarten to 2nd grade): a magic system, a villain and cliffhangers, in words they can sound out, with help on any word they get stuck on. First chapter books, early readers, phonics and sight words. Free to read on any tablet, phone or computer. No ads, no account.
board: Julia and Toby: a dragon series for new readers

headline: Loves dragon books but can't read them yet?
sub: Here is a dragon series they can read on their own.
line: Toby squeezes into the play house. He just fits.
title: Loves Dragon Masters but can't read it yet? A dragon series they can read themselves
description: If your kid begs for one more chapter of Dragon Masters or Beast Quest but can only read "the cat sat on the mat", try Julia and Toby: a fantasy series with a real story, written in words a new reader can sound out. When they get stuck, they tap the word and its sounds appear. Books like Dragon Masters for younger readers, ages 5 to 7. Free to read on any tablet, phone or computer. No ads, no account.

headline: The book that makes them ask for one more chapter
line: She loops the loop! She spins!
title: A first chapter book that makes them ask for one more chapter
description: Julia and Toby is a fantasy series for kids who have just learned to read: a girl, a runaway dragon whose feelings make things float, and a villain waking up far away. Every chapter ends with them wanting the next one, and every word is one they can read. Great first chapter books for 6 year olds. Free to read on any tablet, phone or computer. No ads, no account.

headline: Stuck on a word? Tap it.
sub: The sounds appear right there, so they keep reading on their own.
title: Stuck on a word? Tap it and its sounds appear
description: In Julia and Toby, a new reader taps any word they are stuck on and its sounds appear in place: a dot under one letter, a bar under letter pairs like oo and er, just like in class. Then they keep reading. It never reads the story to them. A fantasy series for kids learning phonics and sight words. Free to read on any tablet, phone or computer. No ads, no account.

sub: Tom reads fantasy. He wrote his little sister a dragon series she can read herself.

title: A 12-year-old wrote his little sister a dragon series she can read herself
description: Tom, 12, loves fantasy books. His sister Yara, 6, loves dragons but could only read baby books. So Tom wrote Julia and Toby: a real fantasy series with a magic system and a villain, in words a new reader can sound out. Now any kid who just learned to read can read it too. Free to read on any tablet, phone or computer. No ads, no account.

headline: When Toby gets cross, things fly

pages.text: Toby gets cross. His spikes stick up.
And then her dolls zoom up, high, high, high! Her drum zooms up. Her tea set zooms up!
Crash! Bang! Smash! They all come down.

title: When the dragon gets cross, things fly: a story new readers can read themselves
description: From book 4 of Julia and Toby: a bee buzzes at Toby, he gets cross, and everything in the play house zooms up. Real excitement, in words a kid who just learned to read can sound out alone. A fantasy series for ages 5 to 7. Free to read on any tablet, phone or computer. No ads, no account.
